appDescription.message: Hover over YouTube thumbnails to read summaries of up to 200 words using your local service and your own AI API key.

intro.message: Summaries of up to 200 words in English or Portuguese.

connectHelp.message: Start the Node.js service and copy the token from data/service-token.txt. This token only connects the extension to your computer.

consent.message: I agree to send the video URL to Tactiq and the title and transcript to my selected AI provider. I understand that a Tactiq tab opens in the background and that AI usage may be charged.

aiHelp.message: Use your own OpenAI or OpenRouter API key. It is stored locally in data/ai-config.json and is never returned to the browser.

keyExisting.message: A key is saved. Leave this field empty to keep it, or paste a new one to replace it.

keyRouterHint.message: Use your OpenRouter account key, usually starting with sk-or-v1-. The local service token belongs only in section 1.

keyOpenAIHint.message: Use your OpenAI API account key. The local service token belongs only in section 1.

modelRouterHint.message: Copy the exact catalog model ID, including its provider prefix.

modelOpenAIHint.message: Enter a model available to your OpenAI API account.

effortHelp.message: Supported levels depend on the model. Use the default when unsure.

testHelp.message: The check queries the key and catalog without generating text, sending transcripts, or saving changes.

importHelp.message: If Tactiq does not return text, generate a transcript and import a .txt file linked to the video.

privacyNote.message: The URL goes to Tactiq; the title and text go to your selected provider. Transcript files stay on your computer. The cache expires after 7 days. There are no ads or telemetry. Tactiq may limit supported languages and videos.

connected.message: Local service connected. Configure your AI provider below.

aiNeedsKey.message: Enter the selected provider’s API key and model.

aiNoKey.message: Model saved. This provider still needs an API key.

checkingAI.message: Checking the key and model without generating a summary…

cacheCleared.message: Summary cache cleared. Files in data/transcripts/ were kept.

importSending.message: Sending the transcript to the local service…

importWaiting.message: The AI provider is preparing your summary…

importDone.message: Summary ready · {count} words. Available when hovering over this video.

consentRequired.message: Allow data processing in the connection section before creating a summary.

actionIntro.message: Open a YouTube video or hover over a thumbnail.

currentUnsupported.message: Open a standard YouTube video to summarize it with this button.
